notes:
ACCESS: direct curl_cffi fetch, no proxy needed - the same route the Furniture pass used. Magento 2 storefront; https://2xlhome.com/ redirects to the /ae-en/ UAE English store. robots.txt was fetched first and it NAMES NO anthropic-ai / ClaudeBot / Claude-Web agent, so the 'User-agent: *' group governs. That group is 'Allow: /' but it carries two rules that shaped this pass: 'Disallow: /*?' (ANY query string) and 'Disallow: /catalog/'. Consequently NO parameterised URL was requested at all - no ?p= pagination, no ?category_ids= layered-nav filter, no catalog/category/view URL (the Furniture pass had used a catalog/category/view URL for one broken node; that route is off-limits here and was not needed, since every bathroom node has a working SEO rewrite). No Crawl-delay is declared; probe.py's 2s per-host gap was applied. Every page below returned HTTP 200 server-rendered HTML on the first or second fingerprint. TREE: taken from the site's own navigation - the level0-level4 category menu rendered in every page's HTML gives the Bathroom branch under Accessories (Accessories > Bathroom > Bath Accessories > {Bath Tray, Bath Tumbler, Soap Dishes, Soap Dispensers, Toilet Paper Holders, Waste Bins}; Bath Textiles; Bathmats; Laundry Baskets; Shower > {Shower Accessories, Shower Curtains, Shower Rods}) plus Kids > Kids Bathroom > Kids Bath Accessories. That was then re-walked node by node through each listing page's own 'subcategories-product-link' tiles (the /accessory/bathroom page's tiles are Bath Accessories, Bath Textiles, Laundry Baskets, Bathmats; the /bath-accessories page's tiles are Bath Tray, Soap Dispensers, Soap Dishes, Bath Tumbler, Toilet Paper Holders, Waste Bins - rows follow that order), and cross-checked against /media/2xlhome/sitemap2xl.xml (3,195 locs), whose bathroom category set is identical to the menu's. QTY: every qty is the server-rendered Magento listing toolbar,
N Item(s)
, on the exact URL in the link column. Nothing was estimated, and no parent number was reused for a child. VERIFICATION - four checks, none of which needed a disallowed query string. (a) H1 + BREADCRUMB on every recorded page matches the node requested, e.g. Bath Tumbler -> h1 'Bath Tumbler', breadcrumb Home > Accessories > Bathroom > Bath Accessories > Bath Tumbler. (b) GRID ENUMERATION: the storefront's page size is 12, and for every recorded category at or under 12 the number of unique a.product-item-link hrefs in the grid equals the header EXACTLY - Bath Tray 5/5, Soap Dispensers 9/9, Soap Dishes 12/12, Bath Tumbler 11/11, Laundry Baskets 3/3, Kids Bathroom 6/6, Kids Bath Accessories 6/6, and the empty Toilet Paper Holders 0/0. Waste Bins (17), Bath Textiles (25) and Bathmats (18) exceed one page and could not be enumerated to exhaustion because ?p= pagination is robots-disallowed; their headers are reported as rendered. (c) CHILDREN vs PARENT: Accessories > Bathroom shows 154 Item(s) and its four children total 153 (Bath Accessories 107 + Bath Textiles 25 + Bathmats 18 + Laundry Baskets 3), the one unit of surplus sitting directly on the parent - the same Magento behaviour the Furniture pass documented. Kids Bathroom 6 equals its single child Kids Bath Accessories 6 exactly. (d) SECOND READ: all thirteen bathroom URLs were re-fetched later in the session with the cache bypassed and every header was identical to the first read (154, 107, 5, 11, 12, 9, 17, 25, 18, 3, 6, 6, 0), so there is no session drift; the numbers also differ per category, so no site-wide constant is being echoed. PARENT-URL RULE: Accessories > Bathroom (154) and Bath Accessories (107) are grouping rows with blank qty and blank link, and Kids Bathroom (6) likewise, because each has extractable children (rules 24 and 38). The Bath Accessories 107-vs-54 gap is documented in review rather than dropped. EMPTY NODES (in the nav and/or sitemap, 0 Item(s), so nothing to record): Bath Accessories > Toilet Paper Holders (h1 'Toilet Paper Holders', breadcrumb correct, 0 Item(s), 0 product tiles), and the whole Shower branch - Shower Accessories, Shower Curtains and Shower Rods each render with the right h1 and breadcrumb but 0 Item(s), while the branch parent /accessory/bathroom/shower itself returns HTTP 404 and appears in neither the sitemap nor the on-page tiles. Had they carried stock, Shower Accessories and Shower Rods would have been Bathroom (rules 6 and 17) and Shower Curtains would have been routed to Textile (rule 20). Toilet Paper Holders as a node is empty, but toilet brush holders DO exist as stock inside the uncategorised Bath Accessories parent (Mica Toilet Brush Holder, Rukham Toilet Brush Holder) - see the review entry. INCLUDED-DESPITE-NAME: Laundry Baskets (3: Kaing Laundry Hamper, Tokri Laundry Basket) is recorded as Bathroom because 2XL files it inside the Bathroom department - its URL is literally /accessory/bathroom/bathroom-storage and its breadcrumb is Home > Accessories > Bathroom > Laundry Baskets - which is exactly the case rule 12 covers (bathroom storage / baskets under a Bathroom hierarchy stay in Bathroom). Waste Bins (17) is likewise Bathroom by hierarchy and by product (Mica Bath Waste Bin 20x25 cm, Rukham Bath Waste Bin 20x25 cm). EXCLUDED - DECOR / FURNITURE MIRRORS (rule 21): /accessory/wall-decor/mirrors with its wall-mirrors and floor-mirros children, /accessory/home-decor/decor-accessories/decorative-mirrors, /furniture/living/living-room-mirror, /furniture/bedroom/bedroom-add-ons/mirrors and /furniture/dining/dining-serve-storage/dining-mirror are all decorative/furniture mirror nodes with no bathroom parent - none of their products are bathroom, vanity, LED, illuminated, demister, shaving or cabinet mirrors. 2XL has NO bathroom-mirror category; the one bathroom mirror product on the site (Caterina Bath Rack w/ Mirror 61x180) is filed inside Bath Accessories and is counted in the review entry's 107. EXCLUDED - VANITIES: the /ae-en/*-vanity-* products (Toor Vanity 204x55x77, Flavio Vanity, Amaia Vanity, Adora Vanity Table, Sierra Vanity Chair) carry the product category string 'Furniture > Bedroom > Bedroom Storage > Dressers' - bedroom dressing tables, not bathroom vanity units, so rule 29 disambiguation keeps them out (no bathroom-vanity category exists on this site). EXCLUDED - PROMOTIONAL / COLLECTION PAGES (rule 25): /accessible-luxury/bathroom, /spring-sale2026/bathroom, /summer-sale2026/bathroom, /extra-10-off/home-decor/bathroom-15off, /under-1000/accessories/bathroom and /under-1000/kids/kids-bathroom are all sale / price-band re-cuts of the same stock. NOT SOLD: 2XL carries no sanitaryware - the 3,195-URL sitemap and the full level0-level4 menu contain no toilets, WCs, bidets, urinals, wash basins, sinks, bathtubs, shower enclosures, screens, shower systems or heads, and no bathroom taps, faucets or mixers. There is also no bathroom-lighting node anywhere, so nothing was routed to Lighting for this company. Nothing was excluded on material grounds.

review.issue: ROUTED TO TEXTILE: h1 'Bath Textiles', breadcrumb Home > Accessories > Bathroom > Bath Textiles. Every product enumerated on the grid is woven bath linen - Naqi Cotton Terry Bath/Hand/Face Towel, Zina Cotton Terry Bath Towel, Ainaz Cotton Terry Bath Sheet, Zayn Cotton Terry Bathmat. Rules 15 and 20 send towels, bath sheets and terry bathmats to Textile.

ROUTED TO TEXTILE: h1 'Bathmats' under Accessories > Bathroom. The assortment is soft textile floor mats (Broc / Tusca / Greco / Koyuki / Hinata / Shizuka Bathmat 50x80CM, Yukio 50x150CM, Dorar Round Bathmat 65x65CM) - no rubber or anti-slip bathroom-accessory mats in the set, so rule 16 sends the whole node to Textile rather than Bathroom.

UNCATEGORISED PARENT STOCK - PARENT URL NOT RECORDED IN ROWS (rule 24). Bath Accessories shows 107 Item(s) but its five non-empty children only account for 54 (5+9+12+11+17). The remaining ~53 products are filed directly on the parent with no child category: PDP checks confirm it (Caterina Bath Rack w/ Mirror 61x180, Enrico Bath Stand w/ Storage 41x84, Tommaso Bath Stand 46x25x111cm and Mica/Rukham Toilet Brush Holders all carry the product 'category' string 'Accessories > Bathroom > Bath Accessories' and nothing deeper). The site's own layered-nav Categories filter on this page lists exactly those five children and no sixth, so there is no deeper URL to record them at. Flagged here with the parent URL and its verbatim header so the stock is visible; it is deliberately NOT in rows because recording the parent alongside its children would double-count (rule 24 / rule 28).
